item.title: God’s Righteousness and the Freedom of Resting in Christ
item.description: In this episode of New Age to Christ, Doreen Virtue teaches on the righteousness of God and the freedom believers have in resting in Christ’s finished work instead of striving through self-effort and perfectionism.

item.title: Why Spiritual Maturity Strengthens Discernment
item.description: Why does spiritual maturity strengthen discernment? In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains from Ephesians 4:14–15, Colossians 1:9–10, and Hebrews 5:14 how maturity produces stability, sound judgment, obedience, and Christlike love—anchoring believers in truth and guarding them from doctrinal error and spiritual instability.

item.title: Psalm 24: The King of Glory and the Call to Holiness
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 24, highlighting God's kingship, the call to holiness, and the triumph of the King of Glory fulfilled in Jesus Christ.

item.title: The Image of God: Foundations for Human Dignity and Christian Worldview
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains the doctrine of the image of God and how it grounds human dignity, identity, and a biblical worldview in this episode of Equipping You in Grace.
